title: Marine cargo occupancy codes
text:
Marine cargo occupancy codes

Touchstone
 9.0 and later support occupancy
 codes for marine cargo occupancies.

The marine cargo occupancy codes are paired with marine cargo construction codes
 2701-2720. Since the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) codes are not mapped to
 1000-series codes, "n/a" indicates that the column is not applicable.

Note:
 The updated 
Verisk Typhoon Model for South Korea
 and 
Verisk Bushfire Model for Australia

 released with 
Touchstone 2025
 in June now support codes
 1001-1012. The 
Verisk Inland Flood Model for Malaysia and Indonesia
 released with 
Touchstone 2025
 in October also support these codes.

Note:
 For information about supported codes and limitations for specific
 models, refer to the model documentation that is available on the 
Client Portal
.

For information about models supporting the marine codes in 
Touchstone
, refer to 
Marine Modeling in Touchstone
, which is
 available on the 
Client Portal
.

| Occupancy code | Category | SIC2-digit | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1001 | Designated Facilities / Vaults | n/a | Facilities that are designed and built to store special types of cargo,
 such as explosives. This often includes higher design criteria or special
 protection measures for contents located in the facility. Vaults and
 protected storage for fine arts and specie. |
| 1002 | Silo | n/a | A tower structure used to store bulk material. |
| 1003 | Liquid Tanks | n/a | Tanks to store liquid material, usually in the port area. |
| 1004 | Gas Tanks | n/a | Tanks containing gas material, usually in the port area. |
| 1005 | Inside Warehouse at Port | n/a | Non-containerized cargoes stored in a warehouse in the port
 area. |
| 1006 | Containerized Inside Warehouse | n/a | Containerized cargoes stored in a warehouse in the port area. |
| 1007 | Containerized Stacked Outside | n/a | Containerized cargoes stored in open areas. |
| 1008 | Open Lot or Stockpiled Outside | n/a | Non-containerized cargoes stored in open areas. |
| 1009 | At Destination in Warehouse | n/a | Non-containerized cargoes stored in an inland warehouse. |
| 1010 | At Destination Retail | n/a | Non-containerized cargoes stored as contents in retail spaces. |
| 1011 | Museums, Institutions, Public Buildings | n/a | Fine arts displayed in museums and art institutions. |
| 1012 | Retail & Private Buildings | n/a | Fine arts and specie stored in private buildings or in retail
 spaces. |
